title: UpstreamReport
description: Produced by SourceSentinel. Consumed by NastechBridge. One per monitored destination per detection run.

upstream_sha.description: New upstream head; equals the mapped SHA when behind_by=0.

behind_by.description: Commits the destination's snapshot is behind the upstream head.

upstream_state.description: history_rewritten -> REQUIRES_REVIEW; needs a human, not a rebuild.
